editorial:
Three female assassins think they are heading into one last easy job for their charming boss, but things spiral into chaos fast. You follow these women as they get tangled up with a psychotic hit man, a grizzled trucker, and a delusional line cook. The story jumps around in time, showing you different sides of the same messy night. It has a gritty, pulpy feel that keeps you guessing about who is really in control. The cast is stacked with familiar faces, and the movie leans into its wild, over-the-top energy rather than playing things safe.

The acting is solid, especially from the leads who sell the tough-girl vibe without going too far. The action is sharp and bloody, and the pacing moves quickly once the pieces start falling into place. On the downside, the story can feel a bit confusing at times, and some characters do not get enough screen time. Still, if you enjoy crime thrillers with a dark sense of humor, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the truth behind the job comes out. The charming boss set the women up, and the psychotic hit man was part of the plan all along. The trucker and line cook are caught in the crossfire. The women fight back, turning the tables on their boss. By the end, most of the bad guys are dead, and the surviving assassin walks away with the money and her freedom, leaving the chaos behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves pulpy crime thrillers with strong female leads.
